myco_chondria_architecture.what_it_is: the organelle that converts 404 demand into ATP (content energy). mycelia + mitochondria.
myco_chondria_architecture.inputs: 404 log entries. each entry = one glucose molecule (raw energy waiting to be processed).

process.glycolysis: parse the 404 path. extract: host, uri, user-agent, timestamp, geo.
process.krebs_cycle: classify the demand: REAL (human/agent wanting content) vs ATTACK (probing .env/wp-admin) vs CRAWLER (robots.txt/sitemap).
process.electron_transport: for REAL demand: check if matching content exists in /data/*.json. if yes: generate page. if no: log as new-demand for manual creation.
process.atp_output: a new O{}G card. O = the address that was 404. {} = content rendered from existing data. G = the endpoint now alive.

automation.step_5: the mycelium has learned what the world wants. it grows TOWARD the demand.
